Acceptance of applications for the Dr. rer. nat.
Before starting your doctoral project, you must complete an application for admission as a doctoral candidate.
Enlarge
The registration of your doctoral project:
Before starting your doctoral project, you must complete the application for acceptance as an applicant in the Campus Portal(Access only via the Munich Scientific Network MWN).
Acceptance of the application for Dr. rer. nat.
Please upload the following documents to the Campus Portal:
Certificate of eligibility from a faculty of natural sciences at LMU
Proof that you have passed the preliminary examination (if a preliminary examination is required, this is noted on the Certificate of eligibility)
Certificate of your university degree: Proof of a relevant degree in a natural science subject (mathematics, computer science, statistics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy, biology, geosciences or similar)
Official, private certificate of good conduct (no older than 3 months, high quality scan, at least 600dpi)
Curriculum vitae with signature
The (old) LMU matriculation number (if available)
Application for acceptance as a doctoral candidate: application form (PDF, 159 KB)
Doctoral supervision agreement (PDF, 98 KB)
Your university degree (high quality scan, at least 600dpi)
APS certificate (only required for degrees from China, India and Vietnam)
The doctoral supervision agreement:
fill out and specify subject area
date
sign
upload into your Campus Portal(Access only via the Munich Scientific Network MWN)
Please send a short email to the Doctoral Office as soon as you have uploaded your signed supervision agreement. This is the only way we can ensure that your registration is reviewed promptly.
After uploading the signed supervision agreement, please send a short email to the Doctoral Office to let us know that you have completed your registration. This is the only way we can ensure that your registration is reviewed promptly
Certificate of eligibility and the preliminary examination
Certificate of eligibility
To be accepted as a Dr. rer. nat. candidate at the Faculty of Medicine, you must prove that you would be accepted as a doctoral candidate at one of the faculties of natural sciences at LMU.
Please contact the faculty responsible for your university degree to request a certificate of eligibility.
The following LMU faculties can issue certificates of eligibility:
Faculty of Biology
Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy
Faculty of Physics
Faculty of Mathematics, Computer Science and Statistics
Faculty of Geosciences
Pre-doctoral examination at the Faculty of Medicine
Students who are only entitled to become doctoral candidates at one of the faculties of natural sciences at the LMU after passing a pre-doctoral examination there, can take the preliminary doctoral examination either at that faculty or at the Faculty of Medicine in accordance with the respective doctoral regulations.
Goal: Proof of knowledge and skills that can be expected to lead to a successful doctoral project
For admission to the pre-doctoral examination, you must submit a written application to the doctoral committee, stating your major subject and two minor subjects. Please contact the doctoral office for more details.
Procedure for the preliminary examination:
The doctoral committee appoints the three examiners and selects the chair
The chair sets the examination date and invites the candidate at least eight weeks before the date and names the examiners.
The pre-doctoral examination is an oral examination (duration approx. 30 - 45 min), topic: the specified major subject and the two minor subjects. The minor subjects must be appropriate to the doctoral project.
